hypothesis: Prior-only selector transition state from Q80 and Q90 (family occupancy entropy and switch rate over the preceding 50 fully active selector labels) adds information about next-target Q7 quintet-universe meta-quality beyond the Q7+Q80+Q90 rolling-state model.
estimand: Target-level mean normalized percentile of the realized quintet across the fixed 1,023 Q7 quintet_score formulas. This is a formula-universe meta-quality forecast, not a winning-quintet or winning-number forecast.

transition_definition.family_entropy: Shannon entropy of the 50-label occupancy distribution divided by ln(K), with K=6 for Q80 and K=7 for Q90.
transition_definition.source_selector_policy: Use only the persisted selected_family field, which each source ledger defines from its own strictly prior rolling selector; never use oracle_best_family_descriptive_only.

walkforward.discovery_predictions: Expanding prequential; each target fit uses only rows with smaller target offsets.
walkforward.holdout_policy: Fit coefficients through the end of Discovery and freeze for Validation and Blind OOS; rolling feature state advances only after target scoring.
walkforward.standardization: Training rows only; fixed alpha; no tuning.

primary_endpoint.statistic: MAE(M2) - MAE(M3); positive favours adding selector-transition state.

inference.multiplicity: One confirmatory primary endpoint (M3 versus M2); all other model comparisons and atlas associations are descriptive only. No endpoint switching.
